notes: A RULING RELABEL. Brandon 2026-10-02 PRE31-C ruling (b): an __attribute__((const)) or CONST declaration is the project's own declaration, not proof that a call has no side effect, and an accessor generated at build time has no body in the scanned files, so a call to it is unproven (strict TP, call-side-effect-unproven). Each row was re-derived at the pinned commit from the macro's definitions and the argument's callees, judged strict (ADR-0015 D5) under the owned-storage ruling. Tag counts: {'call-side-effect-unproven': 5}. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here. The sel4 rows whose FP rested on a CONST-attributed callee being pure: capdl.c:350, objecttype.c:245/758 (IDX_TO_IRQT on the generated cap_irq_handler_cap_get_capIRQ) and thread.c:612/715 (MIN and SCHED_ENQUEUE on NODE_STATE, which calls getCurrentCPUIndex in an SMP build).
